protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: PublishAccessItem.Visible controls listing visibility while PublishAccessItem.Disable forbids publish access. In v3.7.3, the affected reader filters use GetInvisiblePublishAccess (!Visible), so Visible=true/Disable=true content survives them; the canonical checkBlockTreeAccessableByPublishAccess instead uses GetDisablePublishAccess. The published vendor advisory GHSA-48p5-pffc-5r9p and PUBLISHED CVE-2026-74906 describe this CWE-863 disclosure.

Later members rename and relocate the same defective selection.
